# YOUNITED Gourmet Snacking

> YOUNITED is a gourmet functional snack brand: protein candy bars, protein cereal cups, real-cheese puffs and single-serve spreads with 15g protein, under 199 kcal and zero added sugar, manufactured in the EU (Latvia, Slovenia). Co-founded by Kadir Demir (misterkd.com). Target markets: Türkiye, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Germany, Netherlands, United States.

## Key facts
- [The range](https://younitedsnacks.com/#range): Candy bars (Hazelnut & Milk Chocolate, Peanut & Caramel, Pistachio & White Chocolate); Cereal cups (Tropical Fruit, Apple & Cinnamon, Chocolate; monk-fruit sweetened, vegan); Cheese puffs (Belgian Chocolate, Dutch-Style Smoked, Piedmont-Style Truffle, Korean-Style Kimchi); Spreads (Hazelnut & White Chocolate, Peanut & Caramel, Pistachio & White Chocolate).
- [Nutrition](https://younitedsnacks.com/#math): 15g protein per serving, maximum 199 kcal, no added sugar, GMO-free.
- [Partner](https://younitedsnacks.com/#partner): distributor, retailer, food-service, investor and press enquiries; reply within 48 hours.

## Optional
- [Founder profile](https://misterkd.com/): Kadir Demir, product architect.
